sections.title: Data processed
body: The replays you upload, and the stats drawn from them. A replay holds the name and platform id of every player of the match.
If you sign in: your Steam id (SteamID), or your Epic account id and Epic display name.
Technical cookies (see below) and your IP address, hashed, to limit abuse.

sections.title: The other players of your matches
body: They only appear by their name, on the sheets of the matches you uploaded, and never by their platform id. A player anonymized in game stays anonymized.
There is no public profile page and no search by name.

sections.title: Retention
body: Replay files are deleted 30 days after their analysis, or 180 days for a replay read in part, kept to be processed again.
A session without an account expires after 30 days. An account's data is kept until it is deleted.

sections.title: Cookies
body: Only those the service needs: the account session, the session without an account, the course of a sign-in and the chosen language. No advertising or audience cookie.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You can delete your account or your session's data from the settings. For any other request (access, correction): [to complete: contact e-mail].
You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL.

sections.title: Trademarks
body: Rocket League is a trademark of Psyonix LLC. This site is an independent tool, neither affiliated with nor endorsed by Psyonix, Epic Games or Valve. Steam is a trademark of Valve Corporation.

sections.title: The service
body: The tool analyzes the replays you upload and draws stats from them. It is provided as is, without any warranty of accuracy or availability.

sections.title: What you upload
body: Only upload replays of matches you played in. Every file is checked; a file that is not a replay is refused.

sections.title: Your account
body: Signing in goes through Steam or Epic Games; the tool never knows your password. You can delete your account at any time from the settings.

boost.used_per_min: Boost spent, as a share of the tank, per minute of play; the refill to 33 at a kickoff does not count.
boost.avg: The average boost level over play time.
boost.pct_zero: The share of play time spent with an empty tank.
boost.pct_full: The share of play time spent with a full tank.
boost.pads_big: Big pads (100 boost) picked up during play.
boost.pads_small: Small pads (12 boost) picked up during play.
boost.pads_enemy_half: Pads of either size picked up in the opponents' half.

move.speed_avg: The car's average speed over play time.
move.pct_supersonic: The share of play time at 79 km/h or more, the supersonic threshold set by convention.
move.pct_ground: The share of play time 20 cm off the ground or lower; driving on a wall counts as air.
move.pct_low_air: The share of play time in the air, but below the height of a ball resting on the ground.
move.pct_high_air: The share of play time above 7.4 m, high enough to clear a ball resting on the ground.

pos.pct_def_third: The share of live play spent in the third of the field the team defends.
pos.pct_mid_third: The share of live play spent in the middle third of the field.
pos.pct_att_third: The share of live play spent in the third of the field the team attacks.
pos.pct_ahead_ball: The share of live play spent nearer the opponents' goal than the ball.
pos.pct_behind_ball: The share of live play spent nearer their own goal than the ball.
pos.dist_ball_avg: The average distance between the car and the ball during live play.
pos.pct_last_back: The share of live play where the player is the closest to their goal among teammates on the field.

touch.count: The player's touches of the ball during live play.
touch.per_min: Touches of the ball per minute of live play spent on the field.
touch.pct_aerial: The share of touches made above 7.4 m.
touch.pct_hard: The share of touches that change the ball's speed by at least 32 km/h, carries and dribbles aside.

poss.player_pct: The share of live play the team has the ball through the player: from each of their touches to the team's next one.
poss.turnovers_lost: Possessions lost on an opponent's touch while the player was the last of the team to touch the ball.
poss.turnovers_won: Possessions taken from the opponents by a touch of the player.
poss.team_pct: The share of live play the team has the ball: it touches it again within 3 seconds; the rest of the time, the ball is loose.

kick.taken: Kickoffs where the player is the first of their team to touch the ball, within 6 seconds.
kick.won_pct: The share of those kickoffs won: the ball is in the opponents' half half a second after the first touch.
kick.time_to_ball: The average time from the end of the countdown to the player's first touch, over their kickoffs.
kick.goals_conceded: Goals the team conceded within 12 seconds of a kickoff.

duel.won_pct: The share of those duels after which their team has the ball; one that leaves it loose is not won.
duel.beaten: Times the player, going for the ball, was beaten to it by an opponent.

rot.pct_first: The share of time with a role spent as first man: the closest to the ball, more than 2.5 m ahead of the next.
rot.pct_second: The share of time with a role spent as second man: the next closest to the ball.
rot.pct_third: The share of time with a role spent as third man, the furthest from the ball, in 3v3.
rot.double_commits: Double commits the player took part in.
rot.overcommits: Times the whole team was ahead of the ball, by more than 1.5 m, for at least 1 second, while the opponents had it.

event.demos_taken: Times the player's car was demolished.

situations.turnover: A team loses the ball: the opponents touch it, then touch it again within 3 seconds.
situations.kickoff: The restart at the center; won by the team that sends the ball into the other half.
situations.fifty_fifty: Two opponents touch the ball at nearly the same time; won by the team that has the ball afterwards.
situations.double_commit: Two teammates go for the ball together for at least 0.25 seconds, and a touch ends it within 1.5 seconds; the 2 seconds after a kickoff aside.
situations.overcommit: The whole team is ahead of the ball, by more than 1.5 m, for at least 1 second, while the opponents have it.
situations.goal_context: The last 10 seconds of play before a goal, never further back than the kickoff that started the play.

tags.double_commit: A double commit of the team happened in those 10 seconds.
tags.overcommit: An overcommit of the team happened in those 10 seconds.
tags.turnover_own_half: The team's last lost ball in those 10 seconds was in its own half.
tags.beaten_to_ball: A defender, going for the ball, was beaten to it within 3 seconds before the shot.
tags.last_back_far: At the shot, the last defender was more than 20 m from their goal.
tags.last_back_low_boost: At the shot, the last defender had less than 20 boost.
tags.defender_demolished: A defender was demolished within 3 seconds before the goal.
tags.kickoff_goal: The goal came within 12 seconds of a kickoff.
tags.own_touch_last: The last touch before the goal came from the conceding team.
